title.uz: SAT R&W: Words in Context — soʻzning matndagi maʼnosi
title.ru: SAT R&W: Words in Context — значение слова в тексте

body.en:
In a Words in Context question, a short text has a blank, or the question asks what one word means. The right answer is the word that fits this text, not the word you like best.
Three steps:
1. Cover the options and read the whole text.
2. Find the clue: the words that tell you what the blank must mean. Because, so, but and however show which way the idea goes.
3. Say your own word for the blank, then choose the option closest to it.
Example: "The path was so ______ that we walked one behind the other." Clue: one behind the other. Your word: narrow.
body.uz:
Words in Context savolida qisqa matnda boʻsh joy boʻladi yoki bitta soʻzning maʼnosi soʻraladi. Toʻgʻri javob — sizga yoqqan soʻz emas, aynan shu matnga mos soʻz.
Uch qadam:
1. Variantlarni yopib, butun matnni oʻqing.
2. Ishorani toping: boʻsh joy nimani bildirishini koʻrsatadigan soʻzlar. Because, so, but va however fikr qaysi tomonga ketishini koʻrsatadi.
3. Boʻsh joyga mos soʻzni avval oʻzingiz oʻylab toping, keyin unga eng yaqin variantni tanlang.
Misol: «The path was so ______ that we walked one behind the other.» Ishora: one behind the other (birin-ketin). Sizning soʻzingiz: narrow (tor).
body.ru:
В вопросе Words in Context дан короткий текст с пропуском или нужно определить значение одного слова. Правильный ответ — не то слово, которое вам больше нравится, а то, которое подходит именно к этому тексту.
Три шага:
1. Закройте варианты и прочитайте весь текст.
2. Найдите подсказку: слова, которые показывают, что должно значить пропущенное слово. Because, so, but и however показывают, куда идёт мысль.
3. Подберите своё слово для пропуска и выберите самый близкий к нему вариант.
Пример: «The path was so ______ that we walked one behind the other.» Подсказка: one behind the other (друг за другом). Ваше слово: narrow (узкая).

body.en:
Worked example: "Dilnoza checked every answer twice and rewrote her notes neatly. Her teacher praised her ______ work."
1. Clue: checked every answer twice, rewrote her notes neatly.
2. Your word: very careful.
3. Match: "careful" fits. "Quick" and "noisy" do not.
Now you: "Sardor wanted a music player that he could carry to football practice. The one he bought was so ______ that it fit easily into the smallest pocket of his school bag, next to his keys."
1. Clue: fit easily into the smallest pocket.
2. Your word: very small.
3. Match: which option means "very small"?
body.uz:
Namuna: «Dilnoza checked every answer twice and rewrote her notes neatly. Her teacher praised her ______ work.»
1. Ishora: har bir javobni ikki marta tekshirgan, yozuvlarini chiroyli koʻchirgan.
2. Sizning soʻzingiz: juda puxta, sinchkov.
3. Solishtiring: «careful» mos keladi. «Quick» va «noisy» mos emas.
Endi siz: «Sardor wanted a music player that he could carry to football practice. The one he bought was so ______ that it fit easily into the smallest pocket of his school bag, next to his keys.»
1. Ishora: eng kichik choʻntakka bemalol sigʻgan.
2. Sizning soʻzingiz: juda kichik.
3. Solishtiring: qaysi variant «juda kichik» degani?
body.ru:
Разбор: «Dilnoza checked every answer twice and rewrote her notes neatly. Her teacher praised her ______ work.»
1. Подсказка: проверила каждый ответ дважды, аккуратно переписала конспект.
2. Ваше слово: очень тщательная.
3. Сравните: «careful» подходит. «Quick» и «noisy» — нет.
Теперь попробуйте сами: «Sardor wanted a music player that he could carry to football practice. The one he bought was so ______ that it fit easily into the smallest pocket of his school bag, next to his keys.»
1. Подсказка: легко поместился в самый маленький карман.
2. Ваше слово: очень маленький.
3. Сравните: какой вариант означает «очень маленький»?

body.en:
Watch out: the word you know best is often a trap.
Many words have several meanings, and the question asks the meaning in this text. In "The old coat was so worn that the elbows were thin", worn means damaged by long use, not "put on".
A second trap: a word that fits the topic but not the logic. If a text says a team practiced every day for months, "sudden" sounds right for sport but goes against the clue.
Always test your answer: put it in the blank and read the sentence again.
body.uz:
Ehtiyot boʻling: eng yaxshi biladigan soʻzingiz koʻpincha tuzoq boʻladi.
Koʻp soʻzlarning bir nechta maʼnosi bor, savol esa aynan shu matndagi maʼnoni soʻraydi. «The old coat was so worn that the elbows were thin» gapida worn «kiyilgan» emas, «uzoq ishlatilib eskirgan» degani.
Ikkinchi tuzoq: mavzuga mos, lekin mantiqqa mos boʻlmagan soʻz. Matnda jamoa oylab har kuni mashq qilgani aytilsa, «sudden» (toʻsatdan) sportga mosdek tuyuladi, lekin ishoraga zid.
Javobingizni doim tekshiring: uni boʻsh joyga qoʻyib, gapni qayta oʻqing.
body.ru:
Осторожно: слово, которое вы знаете лучше всего, часто оказывается ловушкой.
У многих слов несколько значений, а спрашивают о значении именно в этом тексте. В «The old coat was so worn that the elbows were thin» worn значит не «надетый», а «изношенный от долгой носки».
Вторая ловушка: слово подходит к теме, но не к логике. Если команда тренировалась каждый день много месяцев, «sudden» (внезапный) вроде бы подходит к теме спорта, но противоречит подсказке.
Всегда проверяйте ответ: вставьте его в пропуск и перечитайте предложение.

title.en: SAT R&W: Text Structure and Purpose
title.uz: SAT R&W: Text Structure and Purpose — matn tuzilishi va maqsadi
title.ru: SAT R&W: Text Structure and Purpose — структура и цель текста

body.en:
Every sentence in a text has a job. Common jobs: makes a claim, gives an example, adds a detail, shows a contrast, gives a cause, shows a result, presents a problem, offers a solution.
Three steps:
1. Label each sentence's job in two or three words.
2. Ask what the whole text does. That is its main purpose.
3. Choose the option that matches the whole text, or the sentence the question names.
Example: "Our canteen had long lines. It opened a second window for drinks. Now lunch takes five minutes." Labels: problem, solution, result. Purpose: to show how a change solved a problem.
body.uz:
Matndagi har bir gapning oʻz vazifasi bor. Koʻp uchraydigan vazifalar: daʼvoni ilgari suradi, misol keltiradi, tafsilot qoʻshadi, qarama-qarshilik koʻrsatadi, sababni aytadi, natijani koʻrsatadi, muammoni aytadi, yechim taklif qiladi.
Uch qadam:
1. Har bir gapning vazifasini ikki-uch soʻz bilan belgilang.
2. Oʻzingizdan soʻrang: butun matn nima qilyapti? Bu uning asosiy maqsadi.
3. Butun matnga yoki savolda koʻrsatilgan gapga mos variantni tanlang.
Misol: «Our canteen had long lines. It opened a second window for drinks. Now lunch takes five minutes.» Vazifalar: muammo, yechim, natija. Maqsad: oʻzgarish muammoni qanday hal qilganini koʻrsatish.
body.ru:
У каждого предложения в тексте своя задача. Частые задачи: высказывает утверждение, приводит пример, добавляет деталь, показывает контраст, называет причину, показывает результат, ставит проблему, предлагает решение.
Три шага:
1. Обозначьте задачу каждого предложения двумя-тремя словами.
2. Спросите себя, что делает весь текст. Это его главная цель.
3. Выберите вариант, который подходит ко всему тексту или к предложению из вопроса.
Пример: «Our canteen had long lines. It opened a second window for drinks. Now lunch takes five minutes.» Метки: проблема, решение, результат. Цель: показать, как одно изменение решило проблему.

body.en:
Worked example: "Timur wanted to join the chess team at his school. He lost his first five games. He studied one opening every evening, and by winter he won the school tournament."
Sentence 1: a goal. Sentence 2: a setback. Sentence 3: how he got past the setback.
Now you: "Lola wanted to sing in the school concert. At the first rehearsal, her voice shook so much that she stopped in the middle of the song. She practiced every day in front of her family, and at the concert she sang the whole song without a pause."
Sentence 1: a goal. Sentence 2: a problem. Sentence 3: ?
body.uz:
Namuna: «Timur wanted to join the chess team at his school. He lost his first five games. He studied one opening every evening, and by winter he won the school tournament.»
1-gap: maqsad. 2-gap: muvaffaqiyatsizlik. 3-gap: u bu qiyinchilikni qanday yenggani.
Endi siz: «Lola wanted to sing in the school concert. At the first rehearsal, her voice shook so much that she stopped in the middle of the song. She practiced every day in front of her family, and at the concert she sang the whole song without a pause.»
1-gap: maqsad. 2-gap: muammo. 3-gap: ?
body.ru:
Разбор: «Timur wanted to join the chess team at his school. He lost his first five games. He studied one opening every evening, and by winter he won the school tournament.»
Предложение 1: цель. Предложение 2: неудача. Предложение 3: как он с ней справился.
Теперь попробуйте сами: «Lola wanted to sing in the school concert. At the first rehearsal, her voice shook so much that she stopped in the middle of the song. She practiced every day in front of her family, and at the concert she sang the whole song without a pause.»
Предложение 1: цель. Предложение 2: проблема. Предложение 3: ?

body.en:
Watch out: a true detail is not the main purpose.
Wrong options often describe something that is in the text, but only one sentence of it. For a main-purpose question, the answer must cover the whole text.
Watch the verbs, too. If a text only describes or explains, an option that says it "argues", "criticizes" or "proves" is too strong, even if the topic is right.
Test each option: does it fit every sentence, and is its verb as strong as the text, no stronger?
body.uz:
Ehtiyot boʻling: toʻgʻri tafsilot hali asosiy maqsad emas.
Notoʻgʻri variantlar koʻpincha matnda bor narsani, lekin faqat bitta gapini tasvirlaydi. Asosiy maqsad haqidagi savolda javob butun matnni qamrashi kerak.
Feʼllarga ham qarang. Matn faqat tasvirlasa yoki tushuntirsa, «argues», «criticizes» yoki «proves» deydigan variant mavzu toʻgʻri boʻlsa ham juda kuchli.
Har bir variantni tekshiring: u har bir gapga mosmi va feʼli matndagidan kuchli emasmi?
body.ru:
Осторожно: верная деталь — ещё не главная цель.
Неверные варианты часто описывают то, что в тексте есть, но только одно предложение. В вопросе о главной цели ответ должен охватывать весь текст.
Смотрите и на глаголы. Если текст только описывает или объясняет, вариант со словами «argues», «criticizes» или «proves» слишком сильный, даже если тема верная.
Проверьте каждый вариант: подходит ли он ко всем предложениям и не сильнее ли его глагол, чем сам текст?

title.uz: SAT R&W: Cross-Text Connections — ikki matn orasidagi bogʻliqlik
title.ru: SAT R&W: Cross-Text Connections — связь между двумя текстами

body.en:
Here you get two short texts on one topic. The question asks how they relate: how the author of Text 2 would respond to Text 1 (or Text 1 to Text 2), how the texts differ, or what both authors would agree on.
Three steps:
1. Write each text's view in one line.
2. Name the relation: they agree, they disagree, or one agrees in part (it accepts a point and adds a "but").
3. Apply one author's view to the exact claim the question names. Do not bring in a new idea.
Example: Text 1: homework should be banned because it is boring. Text 2: short homework helps students remember. Relation: they disagree.
body.uz:
Bu yerda bir mavzuda ikkita qisqa matn beriladi. Savol ular qanday bogʻlanganini soʻraydi: Text 2 muallifi Text 1 ga (yoki Text 1 muallifi Text 2 ga) qanday javob beradi, matnlar nimasi bilan farq qiladi yoki ikkala muallif nimaga rozi.
Uch qadam:
1. Har bir matnning fikrini bir qatorda yozing.
2. Bogʻliqlikni nomlang: rozi, rozi emas yoki biri qisman rozi (bitta fikrni qabul qilib, «lekin» qoʻshadi).
3. Bir muallif qarashini savol koʻrsatgan aniq daʼvoga qoʻllang. Yangi fikr qoʻshmang.
Misol: Text 1: uy vazifasi zerikarli, uni taqiqlash kerak. Text 2: qisqa uy vazifasi eslab qolishga yordam beradi. Bogʻliqlik: rozi emas.
body.ru:
Здесь даются два коротких текста на одну тему. Вопрос — о том, как они связаны: как автор Text 2 ответил бы на Text 1 (или Text 1 на Text 2), чем тексты различаются или с чем согласились бы оба автора.
Три шага:
1. Запишите позицию каждого текста одной строкой.
2. Назовите связь: согласны, не согласны или один согласен частично (принимает мысль и добавляет «но»).
3. Примените позицию одного автора к тому утверждению, о котором спрашивает вопрос. Не добавляйте новую мысль.
Пример: Text 1: домашние задания надо запретить, они скучные. Text 2: короткие задания помогают запоминать. Связь: не согласны.

body.en:
Worked example. Text 1: uniforms make students equal. Text 2: uniforms hide clothes, but students still show money through phones and bags.
1. Views: Text 1, uniforms create equality. Text 2, differences remain.
2. Relation: Text 2 disagrees in part.
3. The answer of Text 2: uniforms do less than Text 1 thinks.
Now you. Text 1: the school should replace printed textbooks with tablets, because one tablet holds every book and bags would be lighter. Text 2: tablets are light, but batteries run out and screens crack; the school must pay for chargers and repairs.
1. Views: Text 1, switch to tablets. Text 2, tablets bring hidden costs.
2. Relation: Text 2 agrees that tablets are light, but...
3. The answer of Text 2: ?
body.uz:
Namuna. Text 1: maktab formasi oʻquvchilarni tenglashtiradi. Text 2: forma kiyimni yashiradi, lekin oʻquvchilar boyligini telefon va sumka bilan baribir koʻrsatadi.
1. Fikrlar: Text 1 — forma tenglik beradi. Text 2 — farqlar qoladi.
2. Bogʻliqlik: Text 2 qisman rozi, qisman rozi emas.
3. Text 2 javobi: forma Text 1 oʻylagandek katta taʼsir qilmaydi.
Endi siz. Text 1: maktab bosma darsliklarni planshetga almashtirishi kerak, chunki bitta planshetga hamma kitob sigʻadi va sumkalar yengillashadi. Text 2: planshet yengil, lekin quvvati tugaydi, ekrani yoriladi; maktab zaryadlovchi va taʼmir uchun pul toʻlashi kerak.
1. Fikrlar: Text 1 — planshetga oʻtish. Text 2 — planshetning yashirin xarajatlari bor.
2. Bogʻliqlik: Text 2 planshet yengil ekaniga rozi, lekin...
3. Text 2 javobi: ?
body.ru:
Разбор. Text 1: школьная форма уравнивает учеников. Text 2: форма скрывает одежду, но ученики всё равно показывают достаток телефонами и сумками.
1. Позиции: Text 1 — форма даёт равенство. Text 2 — различия остаются.
2. Связь: Text 2 частично не согласен.
3. Ответ Text 2: форма даёт меньше, чем считает Text 1.
Теперь попробуйте сами. Text 1: школе стоит заменить печатные учебники планшетами — в одном планшете все книги, и сумки станут легче. Text 2: планшеты лёгкие, но батарея садится, а экран трескается; школе придётся платить за зарядки и ремонт.
1. Позиции: Text 1 — перейти на планшеты. Text 2 — у планшетов скрытые расходы.
2. Связь: Text 2 согласен, что планшеты лёгкие, но…
3. Ответ Text 2: ?

body.en:
Watch out: an option can match Text 2 and still be wrong.
The question asks how Text 2 answers one claim in Text 1. Three common traps:
1. The option repeats the view of Text 1, as if Text 2 agreed.
2. The option makes Text 2 more extreme than it is: never, always, completely.
3. The option is true to Text 2 but answers a different question.
If Text 2 says "they are right that... but...", the author agrees in part. Choose the option that keeps both halves: the yes and the but.
body.uz:
Ehtiyot boʻling: variant Text 2 ga mos boʻlsa ham notoʻgʻri boʻlishi mumkin.
Savol Text 2 ning Text 1 dagi bitta daʼvoga javobini soʻraydi. Uchta koʻp uchraydigan tuzoq:
1. Variant Text 1 fikrini takrorlaydi, goʻyo Text 2 rozi boʻlgandek.
2. Variant Text 2 ni haddan tashqari keskin qiladi: never, always, completely.
3. Variant Text 2 ga toʻgʻri keladi, lekin boshqa savolga javob beradi.
Agar Text 2 «they are right that... but...» desa, muallif qisman rozi. Ikkala qismni saqlagan variantni tanlang: «ha»ni ham, «lekin»ni ham.
body.ru:
Осторожно: вариант может совпадать с Text 2 и всё равно быть неверным.
Вопрос — о том, как Text 2 отвечает на одно утверждение Text 1. Три частые ловушки:
1. Вариант повторяет позицию Text 1, будто Text 2 согласен.
2. Вариант делает Text 2 категоричнее, чем он есть: never, always, completely.
3. Вариант верен для Text 2, но отвечает на другой вопрос.
Если Text 2 говорит «they are right that... but...», автор согласен частично. Выбирайте вариант, где есть обе половины: и «да», и «но».

title.en: SAT R&W: Central Ideas and Details
title.uz: SAT R&W: Central Ideas and Details — asosiy gʻoya va tafsilotlar
title.ru: SAT R&W: Central Ideas and Details — главная мысль и детали

body.en:
The main idea is what the whole text says, in one sentence.
Three steps:
1. Read the whole text, not just the first line.
2. Ask two questions: Who or what is it about? What does the text say about it?
3. Put the answers together in one short sentence, then find the option closest to it.
Detail questions start with "According to the text". Their answer is written in the text: find the line that says it, and choose the option that says the same thing in other words.
In a story, follow who acts, what they feel and what changes.
body.uz:
Asosiy gʻoya — butun matn aytmoqchi boʻlgan fikr, bitta gap bilan ifodalangan.
Uch qadam:
1. Faqat birinchi qatorni emas, butun matnni oʻqing.
2. Oʻzingizga ikki savol bering: matn kim yoki nima haqida? Matn u haqida nima deydi?
3. Javoblarni bitta qisqa gapga birlashtiring, keyin unga eng yaqin variantni toping.
Tafsilot savollari «According to the text» bilan boshlanadi. Ularning javobi matnda yozilgan: uni aytgan qatorni toping va xuddi shuni boshqa soʻzlar bilan aytgan variantni tanlang.
Hikoyada kim harakat qilayotganini, nimani his qilayotganini va nima oʻzgarayotganini kuzating.
body.ru:
Главная мысль — то, что говорит весь текст, в одном предложении.
Три шага:
1. Прочитайте весь текст, а не только первую строку.
2. Задайте два вопроса: о ком или о чём текст? Что текст об этом говорит?
3. Соедините ответы в одно короткое предложение и найдите самый близкий вариант.
Вопросы о деталях начинаются с «According to the text». Ответ на них есть прямо в тексте: найдите строку, где это сказано, и выберите вариант, который говорит то же другими словами.
В рассказе следите, кто действует, что чувствует и что меняется.

body.en:
Worked example: "The lost-and-found box at school was always full. The student council began posting photos of found items online. Now most items go back to their owners within a week."
1. About what? The lost-and-found box.
2. What does it say? Photos online get lost items back to their owners.
3. Main idea: posting photos online helps lost items return to their owners.
Now you: "Aziz and his family had never grown vegetables. This spring they turned a corner of their yard into a small garden. By July they were eating their own cucumbers and tomatoes, and they had so many that they gave bags of them to the neighbors."
1. About what? The first garden of the family.
2. What does the text say? ?
body.uz:
Namuna: «The lost-and-found box at school was always full. The student council began posting photos of found items online. Now most items go back to their owners within a week.»
1. Nima haqida? Topilmalar qutisi haqida.
2. Matn nima deydi? Internetdagi suratlar yoʻqolgan narsalarni egalariga qaytaradi.
3. Asosiy gʻoya: topilmalarning suratini internetga joylash ularni egalariga qaytarishga yordam beradi.
Endi siz: «Aziz and his family had never grown vegetables. This spring they turned a corner of their yard into a small garden. By July they were eating their own cucumbers and tomatoes, and they had so many that they gave bags of them to the neighbors.»
1. Nima haqida? Oilaning birinchi tomorqasi haqida.
2. Matn nima deydi? ?
body.ru:
Разбор: «The lost-and-found box at school was always full. The student council began posting photos of found items online. Now most items go back to their owners within a week.»
1. О чём? О коробке находок.
2. Что говорит текст? Фото в интернете возвращают потерянные вещи хозяевам.
3. Главная мысль: фото находок в интернете помогают вернуть вещи хозяевам.
Теперь попробуйте сами: «Aziz and his family had never grown vegetables. This spring they turned a corner of their yard into a small garden. By July they were eating their own cucumbers and tomatoes, and they had so many that they gave bags of them to the neighbors.»
1. О чём? О первом огороде семьи.
2. Что говорит текст? ?

body.en:
Watch out for three kinds of wrong answer.
Too narrow: a true detail, but only one part of the text.
Too broad: it goes beyond the text, often with words like all, always or every city.
Not stated: it sounds sensible, but the text never says it.
For a detail question, put your finger on the line that proves the answer. If you cannot find that line, the option is out, however reasonable it sounds.
body.uz:
Ehtiyot boʻling: notoʻgʻri javoblar uch xil boʻladi.
Juda tor: toʻgʻri tafsilot, lekin matnning faqat bir qismi.
Juda keng: matndan tashqariga chiqadi, koʻpincha all, always yoki every city kabi soʻzlar bilan.
Aytilmagan: mantiqli tuyuladi, lekin matnda bunday deyilmagan.
Tafsilot savolida javobni isbotlaydigan qatorni barmogʻingiz bilan koʻrsating. Bunday qatorni topa olmasangiz, variant qanchalik mantiqli tuyulmasin, uni olib tashlang.
body.ru:
Осторожно: неверные ответы бывают трёх видов.
Слишком узкий: верная деталь, но только часть текста.
Слишком широкий: выходит за рамки текста, часто со словами all, always или every city.
Не сказано: звучит разумно, но в тексте этого нет.
В вопросе о детали найдите в тексте строку, которая доказывает ответ. Если такой строки нет, вариант отпадает, как бы разумно он ни звучал.

stem.en:
After the storm, the river rose so high that it covered the lower part of the park. For two days the benches and the playground stood under brown water, and the city asked people to stay away until the water had ______.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?

options.en: gone down
frozen
risen
warmed up

why.en: The water covered the park, so people must wait until it has gone down. 'Risen' is the opposite, and nothing in the text points to 'frozen'.
why.uz: Suv bogʻni bosgan, demak, odamlar suv pasayguncha («gone down») kutishi kerak. «Risen» buning teskarisi, «frozen» uchun matnda ishora yoʻq.
why.ru: Вода затопила парк, значит, ждать нужно, пока она не спадёт («gone down»). «Risen» — наоборот, а на «frozen» в тексте ничто не указывает.

stem.en:
Sardor wanted a music player that he could carry to football practice. The one he bought was so ______ that it fit easily into the smallest pocket of his school bag, next to his keys.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?

options.en: compact
expensive
colorful
heavy

why.en: The clue is that it fit into the smallest pocket, so it must be very small: 'compact'. 'Heavy' and 'expensive' say nothing about size.
why.uz: Ishora: u eng kichik choʻntakka sigʻgan, demak, juda kichik — «compact». «Heavy» va «expensive» oʻlcham haqida emas.
why.ru: Подсказка: он поместился в самый маленький карман, значит, он очень маленький — «compact». «Heavy» и «expensive» ничего не говорят о размере.

stem.en:
Bekzod and his brother had argued all week about whose turn it was to wash the dishes. Finally their mother drew up a chart with one name for each night of the week, and that chart settled the question for good.

As used in the text, what does the word "settled" most nearly mean?

options.en: resolved
moved into
sank down
paid

why.en: The chart ended the argument about whose turn it was, so 'settled' means 'resolved'. The other options are meanings of 'settle' that do not fit here.
why.uz: Jadval kimning navbati haqidagi bahsni tugatdi, demak, «settled» — «resolved» (hal qildi). Qolganlari «settle» soʻzining bu yerga mos kelmaydigan maʼnolari.
why.ru: Таблица положила конец спору о том, чья очередь, значит, «settled» — это «resolved» (решила). Остальные варианты — другие значения «settle», которые здесь не подходят.

stem.en:
Many people throw away their phones when the screen cracks or the battery gets weak. A small repair shop near Farhod's home offers another choice: it replaces broken screens and tired batteries, often in less than an hour and for much less than the price of a new phone.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?

options.en: To present an alternative to replacing a damaged phone
To explain how phone screens are made in factories
To argue that companies design new phones so that they break quickly
To describe the history of Farhod's neighborhood

why.en: Sentence 1 gives the usual habit, sentence 2 gives another choice: repair. So the text presents an alternative to buying a new phone.
why.uz: 1-gap odatiy holatni beradi, 2-gap boshqa yoʻlni — taʼmirlashni taklif qiladi. Demak, matn yangi telefon olish oʻrniga muqobil yoʻlni koʻrsatadi.
why.ru: Предложение 1 описывает привычку, 2 — другой выход: ремонт. Значит, текст предлагает альтернативу покупке нового телефона.

stem.en:
Lola wanted to sing in the school concert. At the first rehearsal, her voice shook so much that she stopped in the middle of the song. She practiced every day in front of her family, and at the concert she sang the whole song without a pause.

Which choice best describes the function of the third sentence in the text as a whole?

options.en: It shows how Lola overcame the problem described in the second sentence.
It explains why Lola first wanted to take part in the school concert at all.
It describes a second problem that Lola faced at the rehearsal.
It compares the singing of Lola with that of her family.

why.en: Sentence 2 is the problem (her voice shook); sentence 3 tells how she solved it: daily practice, then the whole song at the concert.
why.uz: 2-gap — muammo (ovozi titragan); 3-gap uni qanday hal qilganini aytadi: har kungi mashq, keyin konsertda butun qoʻshiq.
why.ru: Предложение 2 — проблема (голос дрожал); 3 — как она её решила: каждый день репетировала, а потом спела всю песню на концерте.

stem.en:
Two years ago, a small town built a footbridge over its railway line. Before the bridge opened, pupils from the eastern streets had to walk twenty minutes around the station to reach their school. Now the walk takes five minutes, and teachers say that fewer pupils arrive late in the morning.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?

options.en: To describe a new bridge and how it has helped pupils
To criticize the town for taking so long to build a footbridge
To explain how footbridges are built over railway lines
To describe the history of the town's railway station

why.en: Every sentence is about the bridge and what it changed for pupils. Nothing criticizes the town, and the station is only a detail.
why.uz: Har bir gap koʻprik va u oʻquvchilar uchun nimani oʻzgartirgani haqida. Matnda shahar tanqid qilinmaydi, bekat esa faqat bir tafsilot.
why.ru: Каждое предложение — о мосте и о том, что он изменил для учеников. Город никто не критикует, а станция — лишь деталь.

stem.en:
Text 1
Some city planners want to close the old central market and move its sellers to a large new building on the edge of the city. A modern building, they say, would be cleaner, safer and easier for delivery trucks to reach.

Text 2
The central market is more than a place to buy food. People meet friends there, and the small shops around it depend on its crowds. Moving the sellers to the edge of the city might give them a cleaner building, but it would empty the heart of the city.

Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 2 most likely respond to the planners' proposal in Text 1?

options.en: By warning that the move would harm the life of the city center
By agreeing that the sellers should move to the new building as soon as possible
By claiming that the new building would be no cleaner than the old market
By suggesting that delivery trucks should be banned from the city center

why.en: Text 2 accepts that the new building might be cleaner but says the move 'would empty the heart of the city': it warns of harm to the center.
why.uz: Text 2 yangi bino tozaroq boʻlishi mumkinligini tan oladi, lekin koʻchish «would empty the heart of the city» deydi: markazga zarar haqida ogohlantiradi.
why.ru: Text 2 допускает, что новое здание может быть чище, но говорит, что переезд «would empty the heart of the city», то есть предупреждает о вреде для центра.

stem.en:
Text 1
Our school should replace its printed textbooks with tablets. One tablet can hold every book a student needs, and school bags would be much lighter.

Text 2
Tablets are certainly light. But their batteries run out in the middle of the day, and their screens crack when they are dropped. A school that gives up paper books must also pay for chargers, repairs and replacements.

Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 2 most likely respond to the proposal in Text 1?

options.en: By accepting that tablets are light but warning that they bring extra costs
By agreeing that the school should switch to tablets at once, before the next school year begins
By arguing that printed textbooks are lighter than tablets
By claiming that students do not need any textbooks at all

why.en: Text 2 grants that tablets 'are certainly light' (the point of Text 1) but adds the cost of chargers, repairs and replacements.
why.uz: Text 2 planshetlar «are certainly light» ekanini tan oladi (Text 1 fikri), lekin zaryadlovchi, taʼmir va almashtirish xarajatlarini qoʻshadi.
why.ru: Text 2 признаёт, что планшеты «are certainly light» (довод Text 1), но добавляет расходы на зарядки, ремонт и замену.

stem.en:
Text 1
Some coaches believe that young athletes should focus on a single sport from an early age. Years of practice in one sport, they argue, build the skill needed to compete at the highest level.

Text 2
The coaches are right that top performance takes years of practice. But children who play several sports often learn to move in more varied ways, and they are less likely to quit out of boredom. Many of them still choose one sport in their teens, and they come to it with fresh energy.

Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 2 most likely respond to the coaches' argument in Text 1?

options.en: By agreeing that long practice matters but questioning whether it must begin with only one sport
By rejecting the idea that years of practice are needed to compete at the highest level of any sport
By agreeing that children should play one sport so that they do not become bored
By arguing that young athletes should never choose a single sport, even as teenagers

why.en: Text 2 says the coaches 'are right' about years of practice (the yes), then argues for several sports in childhood (the but).
why.uz: Text 2 koʻp yillik mashq haqida murabbiylar «are right» deydi («ha»), keyin bolalikda bir nechta sport turi foydasini aytadi («lekin»).
why.ru: Text 2 признаёт, что тренеры «are right» насчёт многих лет практики («да»), а затем выступает за несколько видов спорта в детстве («но»).

stem.en:
Every winter, Zarina's grandmother knits hats for the children in her building. She starts in September, choosing a different color for each child, and by the first snow every child on all five floors has a warm hat. The children now call her "the hat grandmother."

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.en: A grandmother knits a warm hat for every child in her building.
A grandmother teaches the children in her building how to knit hats.
The children in the building like bright colors more than dark ones.
The first snow in the city comes earlier every year.

why.en: Every sentence is about her knitting a hat for each child. She does not teach knitting, and the colors and the snow are only details.
why.uz: Har bir gap uning har bir bolaga qalpoq toʻqishi haqida. U toʻqishni oʻrgatmaydi, ranglar va qor esa faqat tafsilot.
why.ru: Каждое предложение — о том, как она вяжет шапку каждому ребёнку. Вязать она не учит, а цвета и снег — лишь детали.

stem.en:
Aziz and his family had never grown vegetables. This spring they turned a corner of their yard into a small garden. By July they were eating their own cucumbers and tomatoes, and they had so many that they gave bags of them to the neighbors.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.en: A family's first garden grew so well that they had food to share.
The neighbors taught Aziz and his family how to grow cucumbers and tomatoes.
Cucumbers grow faster than tomatoes in a small garden.
The family's yard was too small for a vegetable garden.

why.en: The text is about the family's first garden and what it gave: enough vegetables to eat and to share. The neighbors only receive bags.
why.uz: Matn oilaning birinchi tomorqasi va undan olingan hosil haqida: oʻzlariga ham, qoʻshnilarga ham yetadigan sabzavot. Qoʻshnilar faqat sovgʻa oladi.
why.ru: Текст — о первом огороде семьи и его урожае: овощей хватило и себе, и соседям. Соседи лишь получают пакеты с овощами.

stem.en:
Last spring, the city put a free bicycle-repair stand outside the main train station. The stand holds a pump and a set of basic tools, each fixed to it with a steel cable, so riders can mend a flat tire or tighten their brakes in a few minutes. Since then, the station manager says, more people have been cycling to their trains.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.en: A new repair stand helps cyclists, and more of them now ride to the station.
The tools at the repair stand are fixed to it with steel cables so that no one can take them away.
Every city in the country should build free repair stands at all of its train stations.
Most people in the city now prefer cycling to driving a car.

why.en: The whole text is about the stand: what it offers and its effect. The cables are one detail; 'every city' and car drivers are not in the text.
why.uz: Butun matn stend haqida: u nima beradi va qanday taʼsir qildi. Troslar — bitta tafsilot; «every city» va haydovchilar matnda yoʻq.
why.ru: Весь текст — о стойке: что она даёт и к чему привела. Тросы — лишь одна деталь, а про «every city» и водителей машин в тексте ничего нет.
